plants.text: Osvald, who had grown up in Flamechurch among the clerics of the Sacred Flame, had once told her that every festival was a ritual with better food.
Even now she still answered to the Blacksnakes, slipping away whenever Mother sent word.
She bought a cup of cider from Orrin, the bald bartender who had set up a barrel beside the stage.
Even Hikari had sent a letter from the kingdom of Sai, which he now ruled, wishing Agnea luck tonight.
Lantern light spilled from the Copper Kettle, a little tavern at the edge of the grounds, as she passed.
